A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the reliability index is computed by the checking point and Monte-carlo method,and the effect of the composite foundation's settlement reliability is analyzed.
we have established the models for the reliability on the composite foundation under the vertical concentrated load,and analyzed the effect factors on the composite foundation's reliability index.

the reliability index of the settlement of composite foundation under a vertical concentrated is 1.5,that of the settlement of the natural foundation is 1.4;the reliability index of settlement of composite foundation is higher than that of the natural foundation.The reliability of the settlement of non-reinforced foundation is lower than that of reinforced foundation;the reliability of the settlement is higher when the foundation is reinforced in a larger area;the reliability index is higher when the coefficient of the composite modulus is higher
The main takeaway from our work is that
we can use a simple, yet effective method to estimate the reliability of composite foundations under vertical concentrated load.
the reliability of the composite foundation can be improved by the reinforcement of the composite foundation.
we have shown the feasibility of the method of reliability analysis on the settlement of composite foundation by using Monte-carlo method.
